Markets.title: Sebi proposes limiting tenure of chief executives, independent directors at exchanges
Markets.summary: India's market regulator has proposed stricter governance norms for stock exchanges and market institutions. The proposed rules limit managing directors to an eight-year tenure and independent directors to a maximum of two three-year terms.

Markets.title: Nasdaq tumbles 2% as Anthropic retreat deepens AI trade concerns
Markets.summary: Anthropic's falling stock price caused the Nasdaq Composite index to drop by 2% amid growing investor skepticism regarding high valuations in the AI sector. Market anxiety is also being driven by concerns over potential interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve despite strong earnings reports from some companies.

Markets.title: Nasdaq crashes 5% at close, erasing 2026 gains; S&P 500, Dow in correction: Stock Market Highlights
Markets.summary: The Nasdaq crashed 5% at the close, completely erasing its gains for 2026. Meanwhile, both the S&P 500 and the Dow entered correction territory during the market selloff.

Markets.title: Rupee climbs past 93/USD as investors seek shelter in Indian stocks, shorts unwind
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee strengthened past the 93-per-dollar level for the first time since April due to over $12 billion in foreign equity investments during November. Hedge funds unwound bearish positions and the Reserve Bank of India took supportive measures, further boosting the currency.

Markets.title: Anthropic's debut rally fades as shares crack 7% in US pre-market trade
Markets.summary: Anthropic shares dropped up to 7.4% in premarket trading on their second day following a broader market selloff and AI sector concerns. This pullback follows the company's record-setting IPO debut where the stock surged 39% before ending its first day up 17%.

Markets.title: Sharp rupee appreciation may cut IT firms' FY27 earnings by up to 13%: Report
Markets.summary: A recent report indicates that a stronger Indian rupee could reduce Indian IT companies' FY27 earnings by up to 13 percent. This appreciation will significantly impact profitability and margins, particularly for firms with heavy exposure to Europe.

Geo-Political.title: Tech stock sell-off drags markets down as Anthropic shares slide
Geo-Political.summary: A sell-off in technology stocks driven by sliding shares in Anthropic dragged down major US markets. This market pressure pushed both the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average into correction territory.

Geo-Political.title: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal, says Burnham
Geo-Political.summary: Following a new agreement on British food exports, emissions trading, and a youth experience scheme, the UK will explore even closer ties with the European Union. Andy Burnham announced these plans after both sides finalized the deal on Friday.

Geo-Political.title: Russian missile hits Poland as Ukraine's allies hold military exercise, says Tusk
Geo-Political.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk reported that a Russian missile entered Polish airspace during military exercises held by Ukraine's allies. Although Warsaw condemned the incident as a Russian provocation, no injuries or damage were reported.

Data & Insights.summary: Taxpayers can declare multiple undisclosed foreign assets for one lakh rupees under the FAST-DS scheme. The Central Board of Direct Taxes clarified that this facility applies as long as the total asset value does not exceed five crore rupees.

Data & Insights.title: RBI eases export paperwork for individuals, sets cap for service exporters
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has simplified export paperwork for individuals. It also established a specific cap to help banks process overseas payments for smaller service exporters more clearly.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Look into wage stagnation’: DEA Secy Anuradha Thakur calls on India Inc to improve employee pay – here’s what she said
Data & Insights.summary: Economic Affairs Secretary Anuradha Thakur has urged Indian businesses to address stagnant employee wages. She stated that improved compensation would help increase consumer spending and support overall economic growth.

Data & Insights.title: Govt weighing ways to boost long-term credit to manufacturing: DEA secretary Anuradha Thakur
Data & Insights.summary: The Department of Economic Affairs Secretary Anuradha Thakur stated the government is exploring methods to increase long-term credit for the manufacturing sector. She also urged large corporations to engage in public-private partnerships, collaborate with smaller enterprises, and tackle wage stagnation.

Data & Insights.title: More economic red signals in October—but not everywhere, shows Mint tracker
Data & Insights.summary: Economic warning signs increased across India in October, though producer and industrial sectors remained resilient. The second half of the year is expected to be more difficult as the positive effects of GST rate cuts and interest rate reductions diminish.

Data & Insights.title: UK inflation hits one-year high of 3.6%: Why are markets less convinced of another rate hike? | Explained
Data & Insights.summary: UK inflation rose to a one-year high of 3.6% in October due to increased fuel prices and tobacco taxes. Despite this increase, steady core and services inflation reduced market expectations for a December Bank of England rate hike.

India.title: "Absolutely No Change":  India Slams Pakistan Over Indus Water
India.summary: India stated that its suspension of the Indus Waters Treaty will remain unchanged. India suspended the treaty following the April 22 Pahalgam terror attack in 2025 that killed 26 people.

India.title: India Says It Backed Speedy Rohingya Return After UN Court Verdict
India.summary: Following a UN court ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, India announced its support for their speedy return. The International Court of Justice found Myanmar in violation of the Genocide Convention during its 2017 operations in Rakhine state.

India.title: 'Hours In Punjab, No Time For Haryana': Deputy Dushyant Chautala Slams Nayab Saini
